item.title: CHARMING HEART
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jungle House Studio
  • 発売日: 2023-07-13
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: CHARMING HEART
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

‘Nut,’ a young man who is constantly harassed and held back in relationships by a group of girls known as “The 4 Celestial Angels.”

But the young woman working as the shop clerk in the dirty magic items store, who only goes by the name “Mia,” lends him a mystery helping hand.

How will he end up? Let’s discover out in the sexist visual novel game Charming Heart, where you can make different decisions and see different outcomes.
